notes:
Account snapshot and POC plan notes:
- Background: large EU payments company, strong data residency and audit requirements. Evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for chat & doc-search workloads.
- Primary ask: deploy a self-contained Redwood Private control plane in customer AWS account (VPC) with Terraform and Helm; KMS integration for model audit/encryption; exportable audit logs to customer CloudWatch/S3; support for SAML SSO and SCIM.
- Tech constraints: must not egress PII outside eu-central-1, HSM/KMS key policy must be customer-controlled, VPC endpoints only, no public IPs on inference nodes.
- POC scope agreed: (1) Deliver Terraform modules + Helm charts for Private control plane + inference nodes in customer VPC; (2) Integrate KMS (encrypt secrets & model artifacts); (3) Wire audit logging to customer's S3 bucket with lifecycle 7 years (compliance); (4) Run smoke tests for latency and KV-cache correctness using sample chat flows; (5) Security review and penetration checklist.
- Timeline: kickoff 2026-03-01 (Fireflies ff_20260301_pegasus_poc_kickoff), infra access by 2026-03-07, first deploy trial 2026-03-14, integration tests 2026-03-21, sign-off call target 2026-03-28.
- Meeting notes/highlights: "We cannot allow model cache dumps out of region" — CTO. They prefer Terraform-first approach and want idempotent Helm for upgrades.
- Integration details: SE Diego leading infra provisioning; provided sample IAM policies (stub) and network diagram in Drive. CSM Aisha to coordinate compliance questionnaires.
- Risks called out: legacy network team slow on endpoint approvals; potential costs for dedicated encrypted model storage; unclear retention SLA for audit log exports.
- Action items (short):
  * Redwood: finalize Terraform module names, provide example variables file for their tagging scheme.
  * Customer: open ticket with infra to allow VPC peering and list required subnets by 2026-03-09.
  * Legal: review DPA addendum draft (sent 2026-02-25).
- Stated win criteria for POC: successful deploy in customer VPC, KMS-backed key usage for secrets and models, audit logs flowing to S3, <120ms p95 inference for short chat flows in EU region, and signed security sign-off.
- Notes style: terse CRM bullets, paraphrases from calls, snippets of quotes.
